title: Vikshep provenance manifest
description: Provenance manifest of one Vikshep computation (VDS-1 section 9.3). Manifests are RFC 8785 canonical JSON. manifest_hash is the lowercase hex SHA3-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical serialization of the manifest with the members 'execution' and 'manifest_hash' removed (the hashed subset). The hashed subset therefore covers schema, operation, inputs, config, filter_bank_sha3, numerics_version, tier2_version, seeds and outputs; backend, platform, executor and wall-clock times are recorded in 'execution' and never change the hash, so two conforming executions of the same computation have the same manifest_hash. Manifests never contain result floats; results are tensors referenced by OID. Shared contract with Vikshep Studio's studio-core. Licence: CC-BY-4.0.

operation.description: Operation that produced the outputs, for example 'scattering', 'reduce', 'compare', 'detect_anomaly', 'train', 'calibrate', 'bench_report'. Hashed.

inputs.description: Input tensors in operation order. Hashed.

config.description: Operation configuration, canonical JSON object (for scattering: J, L, Q, carrier_cutoff, dim, group, max_order, pad, shape; VDS-1 section 14.10). Hashed.

filter_bank_sha3.description: Lowercase hex SHA3-256 of the canonical filter-bank bytes (VDS-1 section 14.3.4), or null when the operation uses no filters. Hashed.

seeds.description: Named 64-bit seeds as decimal strings (for example the master seed of a training run); empty when the operation draws no random numbers. Hashed.

outputs.description: Output tensors in operation order. Hashed.

execution.description: Where and when the computation ran. Not hashed.

name.description: Backend name, for example 'cpu' or the name a registered external backend reports.

platform.description: Rust target triple of the executing build, for example 'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu'.

wall_clock.description: Wall-clock start and end in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, or null when not recorded. Never hashed.

manifest_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA3-256 of the canonical hashed subset (every member except 'execution' and 'manifest_hash').

oid.description: Object identifier: lowercase hex of the first 14 bytes of SHA3-256 of the raw tensor bytes (VDS-1 section 9.2).

name.description: Role of the tensor, for example 'signal', 'coefficients', 'r2', 'log_mean'.

dtype.description: Element type; numbers are little-endian IEEE-754 or unsigned integers, 'utf8' is text.

shape.description: Row-major shape; the raw bytes are the elements in this order, contiguous (VDS-1 section 9.1).
